comparators.install_entrypoint: install the pinned repository per its source-install documentation; exact dependency lock/container identity remains to be frozen
comparators.run_entrypoint: project script `sweagent = sweagent.run.run:main`; invoke `sweagent` with prospectively frozen run configuration
candidate_visible_information: task repository checkout at a pinned base revision
environment observations returned by allowed commands
legal_actions_and_write_surface: shell/editor actions exposed by the agent-computer interface inside an isolated task checkout
no protected evaluator, label, fresh split, host promotion registry or sibling-arm state may be readable or writable
native_errors_timeouts_and_abstentions: retain setup failure, tool error, invalid patch, timeout, budget exhaustion and no submission as distinct typed terminals; do not score missing as zero silently
comparators.p5_eight_class_adapter: External scorer evaluates the native action/patch against protected minimal-revision, preservation, fresh-transfer and harm obligations. The adapter must not infer an eight-class responsibility label from issue resolution, and must not grant actions outside the fixed-agent interface. Unsupported non-code classes remain native failures/unresolved outcomes rather than rewritten successes.
comparators.rights_and_service_dependencies: MIT source; task/upstream repository rights are separate; provider credentials/model terms/container images remain unbound

comparators.install_entrypoint: pinned repository setup.py/profile installation; optional skill dependencies and external services must be prospectively enumerated

token_tool_time_compute_retry_envelope.native_profile: LLM plus selectable scientific tools/services; open-ended unless frozen

native_outputs: immutable typed artifacts with UUID/content hash/agent/skill/topic/parent lineage
agent and global JSONL metadata ledgers
native_errors_timeouts_and_abstentions: retain login/service timeout, tool failure, missing optional dependency, invalid/empty artifact, open need, draft-only and no-post states separately
comparators.p5_eight_class_adapter: Freeze a topic-to-case adapter and external protected scorer. Native artifact/status mutations are not P5 revision classes. The adapter may expose ScienceClaw outputs and candidate-side artifacts but may neither relabel an open need as UNRESOLVED nor manufacture a minimal revision decision. Any candidate modification must remain within isolated candidate artifacts and be scored for preservation/fresh transfer externally.
comparators.rights_and_service_dependencies: Apache-2.0 repository; paper is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; external scientific APIs, Infinite service, models, tool datasets and generated artifact rights require separate terms

selection_statement: ScienceClaw is selected for C6 by the frozen source-grounding and interface-completeness ordering, not by observed P5 performance. MDA v3 is methodologically relevant but its paper-linked NeuronBench repository is a benchmark, not released official solver code.
